blurb: Raymond "Bones" Esckilsen has been a professionally licensed fishing guide in San Antonio for over 14 years. He offers family, company, and group fishing trips focusing on safe, fun, and productive experiences. Specializes in Redfish and fishes various lakes and rivers around San Antonio with seasonal highlights for different fish species.
